description: HR-66 is the designated code for the Regional Transport Authority (RTA) in Mahendragarh, located at the district headquarters in Narnaul. This office primarily handles transport-related administrative tasks for commercial vehicles, including fitness certificates and district-wide permits, while non-transport vehicles are typically handled under separate SDM codes.
address: Nizampur Road, Near Shanti Hospital, Narnaul, Mahendragarh, Haryana
